units.source_text: 到了那里，敲敲大门，一个全不知情的仆人开了门。

en.t: When they arrived there, they knocked at the main gate, and a servant who knew nothing of the matter opened it.

units.source_text: 车子悄悄地赶进院子里。

en.t: The carriage was quietly driven into the courtyard.

units.source_text: 惟光敲敲房间的门，咳嗽几声。

en.t: Koremitsu knocked at the room door and cleared his throat a few times.

units.source_text: 少纳言乳母听得出是他的声音，便起来开门。

en.t: Shonagon, the nurse, recognized his voice and got up to open the door.

units.source_text: 惟光对她说：“源氏公子来了。”

en.t: Koremitsu said to her, "Lord Genji has come."
The nurse said, "The young lady is still asleep.
Why has he come here so late at night?"

units.source_text: 她料想公子是顺路到此的。

en.t: She supposed that the prince had merely stopped by on his way elsewhere.

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“我知道她明天要迁居到父亲那里去，在她动身以前有一句话要对她说。”

en.t: Lord Genji said, "I know she is to move to her father's place tomorrow, and before she leaves I have one thing to say to her."

units.source_text: 少纳言乳母笑道：“有什么事情呢？

en.t: Shonagon, the nurse, laughed and said, "What business could it be?

units.source_text: 想必她会给您一个干脆的回答的！”

en.t: I am sure she will give you a very straightforward answer!"

units.source_text: 源氏公子一直走进内室去。

en.t: Lord Genji went straight into the inner room.

units.source_text: 少纳言乳母着急了，说道：“姑娘身边有几个老婆子放肆地睡着呢！”

en.t: Shonagon, the nurse, grew flustered and said, "There are several old women sleeping disgracefully beside the young lady!"

units.source_text: 公子管自走进去，一面说：“姑娘还没睡醒么？

en.t: The prince went in regardless, saying as he did, "Has the young lady still not woken up?
I will go and wake her myself!

units.source_text: 朝雾景致很好，怎么不起来看看？”

en.t: The morning mist is beautiful; why not get up and look at it?"

units.source_text: 众侍女慌张了，连个“呀”字都喊不出来。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting were so flustered that they could not even cry out "ah."
